text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back from our outing, Kawakami Princess and I passed by a group of children running and laughing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heeey~! How dare you mess up my magic circle~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! Sweep-san,
what's the matter?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What do you mean 'what's going on'?! Those guys are that group of troublemakers everyone at the academy has been talking about lately!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You went and messed up my magic circle...
Grr, that's so frustrating!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, you have nothing to worry about!
I shall give them a thorough scolding~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had she spoken than Kawakami Princess took off running.
I scrambled after her, arriving at—

text_block_list.name: Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, this is bad, Boss! They chased us all the way back to base!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's nothing!
Like I'd ever get caught by an airheaded lady like her!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Did you just call me stupid~?!
For a mere child, you certainly have some nerve!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! In answer to that fiery spirit,
this princess shall thoroughly discipline—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Like, a slightly more peaceful solution...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Indeed, getting serious against children
would hardly be princess-like of me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I should act like a princess—gorgeously, gracefully, bravely...
Doing things fair and square—all right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—You, bully of a boy!
As a princess, I challenge you to a duel!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? A d-duel?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Of course, since my opponent is a child,
I shall provide an appropriate handicap!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I win, you will cease your pranks at once.
Well? Do you have the courage to accept my challenge?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Heh! Now that's interesting!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!
That makes five wins in a row for the Princess~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Brat
text_block_list.text:
T-This is bad, Boss!
He took every single menko card
we had on us!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...?! How can you pack that much
power using only your pinky and
ring fingers...?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! That makes it 17 consecutive wins for me
in hide-and-seek, tag, and kendama...
even with handicaps~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now things are settled once and for all!
From now on, reflect on what you've done and stop your pranks—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
—In... INSAAAANE!!
You're amazing, Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! Do you have some kind of secret trick or something?! How are you so strong?!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Well, back in the day,
I was the toughest neighborhood bully—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—*A-Ahem!*
W-Well, for a princess, being able to ad-lib
something like this is only natural!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
Aweeeesome! Hey, hey, Big Sis!
Take me as your apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
An apprentice, huh~...! Fufufu,
well, I suppose I wouldn't mind taking you under my wing~...?
choice_data_list: Since they asked, let's teach them!
Keep this up and we'll take over the whole neighborhood!
Keep this up and we'll take over the whole neighborhood!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
An apprentice, huh~...! Fufufu,
well, I suppose I wouldn't mind taking you under my wing~...?
choice_data_list: Since they asked, let's teach them!
Keep this up and we'll take over the whole neighborhood!
Keep this up and we'll take over the whole neighborhood!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, if you say so, Trainer...
Very well! As of today, you are officially the Princess's apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!!
Then, then, teach me that trick
you did earlier right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
I shall train you to become peerless under the heavens~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Kawakami Princess taught the children
her secret techniques and all sorts of games
she knew.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Brat
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Big sis here is invincible!
She totally beat up those kids in the next park!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Let's go right away, Sis!
Come on, this way, this way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? W-Why did it turn out like this!?
W-Wait just a moment, please—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess was completely swarmed
by the children... and dragged off
to join their campaign of conquest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Waaaaaaah!!
T-This makes me look like a playground bully instead of a princess~!
